title: Your week, and a dividends leaderboard

changes.text: After each Saturday review, Home shows your week for a few days: what you made, your dividends and share fees, what your oshi saved you, your biggest moves and your rank, with a link to the full breakdown. In the last three days before the next review, it counts down.

The leaderboard has a Dividends tab: everyone from the most earned down to the highest fees, for the latest week or all time. Open a player to see their dividends, fees and what their oshi saved them, stock by stock.
